body.p: After sweep 3 (). Owns the additive field of include/sxml/schema.h (with ), src/schema_assemble.c, src/function_library_schema.c, the use-xsi-schema-location hunks of src/function_library_json.c, src/function_library_node.c, src/function_library_xslt.c and src/function_library_core_internal.h, apps/sxml/command_validate.c, tests/cli/ (validate_hints), tests/xsd/driver/, third_party/w3c-xlink/, the book's "Schema hints in documents". XSD 1.1 Part 1, 4.3.2: the hints of an instance join the assembly when the host asks; fn:xsd-validator's use-xsi-schema-location works; sxml validate follows hints with a flag; xlink.xsd vendored so that the introspection set runs. *Done** 2026-10-20 (): schema_location_hint_node, hints only for namespaces the schema lacks; fn:xsd-validator, fn:doc, fn:doc-available, fn:parse-xml and fn:document; XQuery validate and XSLT validation keep ignoring hints; sxml validate --use-schema-location; the XSD driver through the library; the QT4 driver's schema-location-hint. XSD11 41,507 to 41,599 (the 92 introspection tests), 11 failed unchanged; QT4 schema-aware XQ40 11,691 to 11,696; XT40 schema-aware 4,084 to 4,087; none lost.
